purpose: Fictional demo portraits for GrowingUp App Store screenshot concepts and later simulator fixtures

assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original demo portrait photo for GrowingUp iPhone App Store screenshots, not a mockup. Create one photorealistic natural editorial photograph, portrait orientation 2:3, high resolution. Soft natural window/daylight, candid believable texture, clean muted background. Frame subject's head and upper torso in the central half of the image, ample uncluttered darkened negative space in the top quarter for the app's white name and age overlay. Composition must also work cropped into a small circular widget avatar. Entirely fictional subject, no resemblance to a named real person. No text, logos, watermarks, app UI, collage, borders, or illustration. Subject: happy 10-month-old baby girl with light brown wispy hair, warm natural smile, wearing a simple cream knitted sweater, seated safely on a cozy sage-green sofa at home. Gentle authentic family photography, warm daylight, understated cream and sage palette.
